description:
Does the Adventist Church promote two different gospels even within it's own walls? SDA Pastor Dennis Priebe (@DennisPriebeMinistries) believes so. But what is the real Gospel?

Richard Foster, friend and former Seventh-Day Adventist, joins me to review and respond to a message given by Mr. Priebe who is known for his strong stance on Last Generation Theology (LGT). In his presentation, he gives us a perfect example of the confusion that exists within Adventist theology regarding something as foundational as the gospel. But he also provides a perfect example for us of how many leaders within the SDA Church are ignorant of what Christian's actually believe.
